bun.WebView: Native GUI bridge can open windows, browser processes and network connections.
bun.fetch: OPEN until S0c: immutable Bun.fetch uses proxy listener by default; explicit proxy or unix options bypass it.

modules.bun:ffi: Native FFI can call arbitrary OS functions, including sockets, processes and wall clocks.
modules.bun:wrap: Internal native wrapper bridge can expose native functions and real OS effects.
modules.module: Native addon loading through the module loader can execute arbitrary native OS effects.

globals.ffi: Native FFI can call arbitrary OS functions, including sockets, processes and wall clocks.

open_until_S0c.Bun.fetch.proxy: Per-request proxy selects another proxy, bypassing the parent listener.
open_until_S0c.Bun.fetch.unix: Per-request unix connects to a local socket, bypassing the parent listener.
open_until_S0c.process.env/Bun.env proxy edits: Runtime refuses frozen env descriptors; edits can bypass inherited proxy routing on 1.4.4.
